Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the billing friction. We put INV-7789 on hold pending resale evidence that meets our acceptance checklist. To move forward we need the following: 

- Signed resale certificate (state form or multi-state blanket) with matching EIN to the billing entity on the invoice
- W-9 for tax entity verification (if not already provided)
- Ship-to / sold-to mapping (showing which Redwood invoice line items map to covered ship-to addresses)
- If your state requires it, notarized signature or state verification stamp (see spreadsheet attached)

Preferred upload: secure portal (link below). If you’d rather, you can send via DocuSign/secure email — do not send sensitive docs to public Gmail.

Quick checklist attached: resale_acceptance_checklist.xlsx (formats we accept and common rejection reasons). Once we confirm EIN/address match and document completeness, Finance will release the hold and pay INV-7789. If anything is unclear, Ben will help triage.
